component.name: Music DL
component.summary: Download music from YouTube, SoundCloud and Spotify

description.p: Music DL is a small desktop app that downloads audio from YouTube, SoundCloud and Spotify and saves it in the format of your choice.

Paste one or more links, pick an output folder and format, and the app queues the downloads. Playlists and albums are expanded automatically, and tracks can be tagged with title, artist, album and cover art.
Spotify links are matched to the best available audio on YouTube, since Spotify does not provide public audio streams.
